extraction.Name: Louisa Twiss
extraction.Refused/Protested: she did not want the patent and would not have signed the receipt had she known what it was about
extraction.Recorded patent: she received a receipt for her patent, together with a letter from the Superintendent asking her to sign and return the receipt, and not knowing just what it was about, she signed the receipt and returned it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold it to a white man in Kadoka, So. Dak. whose his name she does not know, for $1500.00, and he was to pay the taxes
extraction.Buyer: a white man in Kadoka, So. Dak. whose his name she does not know, for $1500.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: she could not pay the taxes so she was about to lose the land so she sold it
extraction.Occupation/Income: draws a pension as the widow of an Indian Scout of $30.00 per month and that is all she lives on
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent and in poor health, having heart trouble and short of wind; has one minor child; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since she was granted a patent to her land; she received all the money from the sale; document notarized November 30, 1928, in Shannon County, South Dakota | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Pine Ridge (Shannon County, South Dakota)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')

recovery_notes.rationale: Pine Ridge tribe field had 40+ string variants across the corpus. Consolidating to canonical 'Pine Ridge' for clean tabulation while preserving original variant in NOTES for audit.
